_about: SYNTHETIC bill pages for tools/gate-bill-ground-truth.js: City pages (provider city; fake school, fake street, fake account 01-9001-00) and Utility E Billing Details pages (provider utility-e; fake school, fake address, synthetic account id). Built by make-bill-ground-truth-synthetic.js from the reference coordinates of each template (computations/bill-layout.js CITY_NEW, UTILITY_E_BD). rereads = canned crop-OCR readings per value cell and config (gate cache key).
